public_rationale: Menlo's December 9, 2025 report estimated that OpenAI's enterprise LLM API market share fell from 50% in 2023 to 27% in 2025, while Anthropic reached 40% [e1]. Google reported on November 18, 2025 that Gemini 3 Pro topped LMArena [e2]. Together, these findings support substantial erosion of OpenAI's competitive advantage in enterprise adoption and model capabilities [e1, e2]. OpenAI still reported a state-of-the-art GDPval score for GPT-5.2 Thinking on December 11, 2025; that continuing strength does not negate the enterprise-share decline [e1, e3].
limitations: The evidence does not establish loss of consumer or total revenue leadership.
Menlo's figures are survey-based estimates, and Menlo lists Anthropic among its investments [e1].
The capability evidence consists of company disclosures and does not establish an exact ranking on December 20, 2025 [e2, e3].
The assessment uses the contract's 2023 baseline and interpretation of competitive lead.

statement.document_title: Six (or seven) predictions for AI 2026 from a Generative AI realist

our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is substantial erosion of OpenAI's competitive advantage in frontier models and adoption, not a claim that it trails every competitor in every market.
I use 2023 as the earlier comparison baseline and observations available through December 20, 2025. Marcus does not name the baseline.
A large documented decline in enterprise position alongside competitors reaching the capability frontier counts as substantial erosion.
Enterprise adoption and capability results do not establish consumer leadership, total company revenue leadership or durable future advantage.
criteria.support_condition: Dated comparative evidence shows a substantial narrowing or reversal of OpenAI's earlier advantage in important capability or adoption measures, with corroboration across those dimensions.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evidence shows OpenAI maintaining or widening its earlier advantage across the relevant capability and adoption measures. Winning selected benchmarks alone does not refute erosion elsewhere.
